<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Output Truncation</h3><a id="user-content-output-truncation" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Output Truncation" href="#output-truncation"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Tools MUST truncate their output</strong> to avoid overwhelming the LLM context. Large outputs can cause:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Context overflow errors (prompt too long)</li>
<li>Compaction failures</li>
<li>Degraded model performance</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">The built-in limit is <strong>50KB</strong> (~10k tokens) and <strong>2000 lines</strong>, whichever is hit first. Use the exported truncation utilities:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-ts notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="import {
  truncateHead,      // Keep first N lines/bytes (good for file reads, search results)
  truncateTail,      // Keep last N lines/bytes (good for logs, command output)
  truncateLine,      // Truncate a single line to maxBytes with ellipsis
  formatSize,        // Human-readable size (e.g., "50KB", "1.5MB")
  DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES, // 50KB
  DEFAULT_MAX_LINES, // 2000
} from "@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent";

async execute(toolCallId, params, signal, onUpdate, ctx) {
  const output = await runCommand();

  // Apply truncation
  const truncation = truncateHead(output, {
    maxLines: DEFAULT_MAX_LINES,
    maxBytes: DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES,
  });

  let result = truncation.content;

  if (truncation.truncated) {
    // Write full output to temp file
    const tempFile = writeTempFile(output);

    // Inform the LLM where to find complete output
    result += `\n\n[Output truncated: ${truncation.outputLines} of ${truncation.totalLines} lines`;
    result += ` (${formatSize(truncation.outputBytes)} of ${formatSize(truncation.totalBytes)}).`;
    result += ` Full output saved to: ${tempFile}]`;
  }

  return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result }] };
}"><pre><span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
  <span class="pl-s1">truncateHead</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>      <span class="pl-c">// Keep first N lines/bytes (good for file reads, search results)</span>
  <span class="pl-s1">truncateTail</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>      <span class="pl-c">// Keep last N lines/bytes (good for logs, command output)</span>
  <span class="pl-s1">truncateLine</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>      <span class="pl-c">// Truncate a single line to maxBytes with ellipsis</span>
  <span class="pl-s1">formatSize</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>        <span class="pl-c">// Human-readable size (e.g., "50KB", "1.5MB")</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c">// 50KB</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">DEFAULT_MAX_LINES</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c">// 2000</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span> <span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s">"@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent"</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<span class="pl-en">async</span> <span class="pl-s1">execute</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">toolCallId</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">params</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">signal</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">onUpdate</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">ctx</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos"></span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
  <span class="pl-k">const</span> <span class="pl-s1">output</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-k">await</span> <span class="pl-en">runCommand</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

  <span class="pl-c">// Apply truncation</span>
  <span class="pl-k">const</span> <span class="pl-s1">truncation</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">truncateHead</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">output</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
    <span class="pl-c1">maxLines</span>: <span class="pl-c1">DEFAULT_MAX_LINES</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
    <span class="pl-c1">maxBytes</span>: <span class="pl-c1">DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>

    <span class="pl-c">// Write full output to temp file</span>
    <span class="pl-k">const</span> <span class="pl-s1">tempFile</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">writeTempFile</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">output</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

    <span class="pl-s1">result</span> <span class="pl-c1">+=</span> <span class="pl-s">` (<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">${</span><span class="pl-en">formatSize</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">truncation</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">outputBytes</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">}</span></span> of <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">${</span><span class="pl-en">formatSize</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">truncation</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">totalBytes</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">}</span></span>).`</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">result</span> <span class="pl-c1">+=</span> <span class="pl-s">` Full output saved to: <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">${</span><span class="pl-s1">tempFile</span><span class="pl-kos">}</span></span>]`</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">}</span>

  <span class="pl-k">return</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span> <span class="pl-c1">content</span>: <span class="pl-kos">[</span><span class="pl-kos">{</span> <span class="pl-c1">type</span>: <span class="pl-s">"text"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">text</span>: <span class="pl-s1">result</span> <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">]</span> <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Key points:</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Use <code>truncateHead</code> for content where the beginning matters (search results, file reads)</li>
<li>Use <code>truncateTail</code> for content where the end matters (logs, command output)</li>
<li>Always inform the LLM when output is truncated and where to find the full version</li>
<li>Document the truncation limits in your tool's description</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">See <a href="/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/truncated-tool.ts">examples/extensions/truncated-tool.ts</a> for a complete example wrapping <code>rg</code> (ripgrep) with proper truncation.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Custom Rendering</h3><a id="user-content-custom-rendering" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Custom Rendering" href="#custom-rendering"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Tools can provide <code>renderCall</code> and <code>renderResult</code> for custom TUI display. See <a href="/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/docs/tui.md">tui.md</a> for the full component API and <a href="https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/components/tool-execution.ts">tool-execution.ts</a> for how tool rows are composed.</p>
<p dir="auto">Tool output is wrapped in a <code>Box</code> that handles padding and background. A defined <code>renderCall</code> or <code>renderResult</code> must return a <code>Component</code>. If a slot renderer is not defined, <code>tool-execution.ts</code> uses fallback rendering for that slot.</p>
<p dir="auto"><code>renderCall</code> and <code>renderResult</code> each receive a <code>context</code> object with:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>args</code> - the current tool call arguments</li>
<li><code>state</code> - shared row-local state across <code>renderCall</code> and <code>renderResult</code></li>
<li><code>lastComponent</code> - the previously returned component for that slot, if any</li>
<li><code>invalidate()</code> - request a rerender of this tool row</li>
<li><code>toolCallId</code>, <code>cwd</code>, <code>executionStarted</code>, <code>argsComplete</code>, <code>isPartial</code>, <code>expanded</code>, <code>showImages</code>, <code>isError</code></li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Use <code>context.state</code> for cross-slot shared state. Keep slot-local caches on the returned component instance when you want to reuse and mutate the same component across renders.</p>

<p dir="auto">Renders the tool result or output:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-ts notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="renderResult(result, { expanded, isPartial }, theme, context) {
  if (isPartial) {
    return new Text(theme.fg("warning", "Processing..."), 0, 0);
  }

  if (result.details?.error) {
    return new Text(theme.fg("error", `Error: ${result.details.error}`), 0, 0);
  }

  let text = theme.fg("success", "✓ Done");
  if (expanded && result.details?.items) {
    for (const item of result.details.items) {
      text += "\n  " + theme.fg("dim", item);
    }
  }
  return new Text(text, 0, 0);
}"><pre><span class="pl-en">renderResult</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">result</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span> expanded<span class="pl-kos">,</span> isPartial <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">theme</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">context</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos"></span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>

  <span class="pl-k">if</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">expanded</span> <span class="pl-c1">&&</span> <span class="pl-s1">result</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">details</span><span class="pl-kos">?.</span><span class="pl-c1">items</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>

      <span class="pl-s1">text</span> <span class="pl-c1">+=</span> <span class="pl-s">"\n  "</span> <span class="pl-c1">+</span> <span class="pl-s1">theme</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">fg</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">"dim"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">item</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
    <span class="pl-kos">}</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">}</span>
  <span class="pl-k">return</span> <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-v">Text</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">text</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">0</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">0</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">If a slot intentionally has no visible content, return an empty <code>Component</code> such as an empty <code>Container</code>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Keybinding Hints</h4><a id="user-content-keybinding-hints" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Keybinding Hints" href="#keybinding-hints"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Use <code>keyHint()</code> to display keybinding hints that respect the active keybinding configuration:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-ts notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="import { keyHint } from "@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent";

renderResult(result, { expanded }, theme, context) {
  let text = theme.fg("success", "✓ Done");
  if (!expanded) {
    text += ` (${keyHint("app.tools.expand", "to expand")})`;
  }
  return new Text(text, 0, 0);
}"><pre><span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span> <span class="pl-s1">keyHint</span> <span class="pl-kos">}</span> <span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s">"@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent"</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<span class="pl-en">renderResult</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">result</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span> expanded <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">theme</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">context</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos"></span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
  <span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">text</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">theme</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">fg</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">"success"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">"✓ Done"</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
  <span class="pl-k">if</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">!</span><span class="pl-s1">expanded</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">text</span> <span class="pl-c1">+=</span> <span class="pl-s">` (<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">${</span><span class="pl-en">keyHint</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">"app.tools.expand"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">"to expand"</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">}</span></span>)`</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">}</span>
  <span class="pl-k">return</span> <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-v">Text</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">text</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">0</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">0</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Available functions:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>keyHint(keybinding, description)</code> - Formats a configured keybinding id such as <code>"app.tools.expand"</code> or <code>"tui.select.confirm"</code></li>
<li><code>keyText(keybinding)</code> - Returns the raw configured key text for a keybinding id</li>
<li><code>rawKeyHint(key, description)</code> - Format a raw key string</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Use namespaced keybinding ids:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Coding-agent ids use the <code>app.*</code> namespace, for example <code>app.tools.expand</code>, <code>app.editor.external</code>, <code>app.session.rename</code></li>
<li>Shared TUI ids use the <code>tui.*</code> namespace, for example <code>tui.select.confirm</code>, <code>tui.select.cancel</code>, <code>tui.input.tab</code></li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">For the exhaustive list of keybinding ids and defaults, see <a href="/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/docs/keybindings.md">keybindings.md</a>. <code>keybindings.json</code> uses those same namespaced ids.</p>
<p dir="auto">Custom editors and <code>ctx.ui.custom()</code> components receive <code>keybindings: KeybindingsManager</code> as an injected argument. They should use that injected manager directly instead of calling <code>getKeybindings()</code> or <code>setKeybindings()</code>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Best Practices</h4><a id="user-content-best-practices" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Best Practices" href="#best-practices"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Use <code>Text</code> with padding <code>(0, 0)</code>. The Box handles padding.</li>
<li>Use <code>\n</code> for multi-line content.</li>
<li>Handle <code>isPartial</code> for streaming progress.</li>
<li>Support <code>expanded</code> for detail on demand.</li>
<li>Keep default view compact.</li>
<li>Read <code>context.args</code> in <code>renderResult</code> instead of copying args into <code>context.state</code>.</li>
<li>Use <code>context.state</code> only for data that must be shared across call and result slots.</li>
<li>Reuse <code>context.lastComponent</code> when the same component instance can be updated in place.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Fallback</h4><a id="user-content-fallback" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Fallback" href="#fallback"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">If a slot renderer is not defined or throws:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>renderCall</code>: Shows the tool name</li>
<li><code>renderResult</code>: Shows raw text from <code>content</code></li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Custom UI</h2><a id="user-content-custom-ui" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Custom UI" href="#custom-ui"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Extensions can interact with users via <code>ctx.ui</code> methods and customize how messages/tools render.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>For custom components, see <a href="/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/docs/tui.md">tui.md</a></strong> which has copy-paste patterns for:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Selection dialogs (SelectList)</li>
<li>Async operations with cancel (BorderedLoader)</li>
<li>Settings toggles (SettingsList)</li>
<li>Status indicators (setStatus)</li>

</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Dialogs</h3><a id="user-content-dialogs" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Dialogs" href="#dialogs"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-ts notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="// Select from options

<span class="pl-k">const</span> <span class="pl-s1">choice</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-k">await</span> <span class="pl-s1">ctx</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">ui</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">select</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">"Pick one:"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-kos">[</span><span class="pl-s">"A"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">"B"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">"C"</span><span class="pl-kos">]</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<span class="pl-c">// Confirm dialog</span>
<span class="pl-k">const</span> <span class="pl-s1">ok</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-k">await</span> <span class="pl-s1">ctx</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">ui</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">confirm</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">"Delete?"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">"This cannot be undone"</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Timed Dialogs with Countdown</h4><a id="user-content-timed-dialogs-with-countdown" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Timed Dialogs with Countdown" href="#timed-dialogs-with-countdown"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Dialogs support a <code>timeout</code> option that auto-dismisses with a live countdown display:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-ts notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="// Dialog shows "Title (5s)" → "Title (4s)" → ... → auto-dismisses at 0
const confirmed = await ctx.ui.confirm(
  "Timed Confirmation",
  "This dialog will auto-cancel in 5 seconds. Confirm?",
  { timeout: 5000 }
);

if (confirmed) {
  // User confirmed
} else {
  // User cancelled or timed out
}"><pre><span class="pl-c">// Dialog shows "Title (5s)" → "Title (4s)" → ... → auto-dismisses at 0</span>
<span class="pl-k">const</span> <span class="pl-s1">confirmed</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-k">await</span> <span class="pl-s1">ctx</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">ui</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">confirm</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span>
  <span class="pl-s">"Timed Confirmation"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-s">"This dialog will auto-cancel in 5 seconds. Confirm?"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">{</span> <span class="pl-c1">timeout</span>: <span class="pl-c1">5000</span> <span class="pl-kos">}</span>
<span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<span class="pl-k">if</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">confirmed</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
  <span class="pl-c">// User confirmed</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span> <span class="pl-k">else</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
  <span class="pl-c">// User cancelled or timed out</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Return values on timeout:</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>select()</code> returns <code>undefined</code></li>
<li><code>confirm()</code> returns <code>false</code></li>
<li><code>input()</code> returns <code>undefined</code></li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Manual Dismissal with AbortSignal</h4><a id="user-content-manual-dismissal-with-abortsignal" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Manual Dismissal with AbortSignal" href="#manual-dismissal-with-abortsignal"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">For more control (e.g., to distinguish timeout from user cancel), use <code>AbortSignal</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-ts notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="const controller = new AbortController();
const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 5000);

const confirmed = await ctx.ui.confirm(
  "Timed Confirmation",
  "This dialog will auto-cancel in 5 seconds. Confirm?",
  { signal: controller.signal }
);

clearTimeout(timeoutId);

if (confirmed) {
  // User confirmed
} else if (controller.signal.aborted) {
  // Dialog timed out
} else {

    <span class="pl-k">if</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">key</span> <span class="pl-c1">===</span> <span class="pl-s">"escape"</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-en">done</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">false</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
    <span class="pl-k">return</span> <span class="pl-c1">true</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<span class="pl-k">if</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">result</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
  <span class="pl-c">// User pressed Enter</span>

<p dir="auto">The callback receives:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>tui</code> - TUI instance (for screen dimensions, focus management)</li>
<li><code>theme</code> - Current theme for styling</li>
<li><code>keybindings</code> - App keybinding manager (for checking shortcuts)</li>
<li><code>done(value)</code> - Call to close component and return value</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">See <a href="/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/docs/tui.md">tui.md</a> for the full component API.</p>

<p dir="auto">Replace the main input editor with a custom implementation (vim mode, emacs mode, etc.):</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-ts notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="import { CustomEditor, type ExtensionAPI } from "@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent";
import { matchesKey } from "@mariozechner/pi-tui";

class VimEditor extends CustomEditor {
  private mode: "normal" | "insert" = "insert";

  handleInput(data: string): void {
    if (matchesKey(data, "escape") && this.mode === "insert") {
      this.mode = "normal";
      return;
    }
    if (this.mode === "normal" && data === "i") {
      this.mode = "insert";
      return;
    }
    super.handleInput(data);  // App keybindings + text editing
  }
}

export default function (pi: ExtensionAPI) {
  pi.on("session_start", (_event, ctx) => {
    ctx.ui.setEditorComponent((_tui, theme, keybindings) =>
      new VimEditor(theme, keybindings)
    );
  });
}"><pre><span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span> <span class="pl-v">CustomEditor</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-k">type</span> <span class="pl-v">ExtensionAPI</span> <span class="pl-kos">}</span> <span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s">"@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent"</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
<span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span> <span class="pl-s1">matchesKey</span> <span class="pl-kos">}</span> <span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s">"@mariozechner/pi-tui"</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<span class="pl-k">class</span> <span class="pl-smi">VimEditor</span> <span class="pl-k">extends</span> <span class="pl-v">CustomEditor</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
  <span class="pl-k">private</span> <span class="pl-c1">mode</span>: <span class="pl-s">"normal"</span> <span class="pl-c1">|</span> <span class="pl-s">"insert"</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s">"insert"</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

  <span class="pl-en">handleInput</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">data</span>: <span class="pl-smi">string</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>: <span class="pl-smi"><span class="pl-k">void</span></span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
    <span class="pl-k">if</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-en">matchesKey</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">data</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">"escape"</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c1">&&</span> <span class="pl-smi">this</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">mode</span> <span class="pl-c1">===</span> <span class="pl-s">"insert"</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
      <span class="pl-smi">this</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">mode</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s">"normal"</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
      <span class="pl-k">return</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
    <span class="pl-kos">}</span>
    <span class="pl-k">if</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-smi">this</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">mode</span> <span class="pl-c1">===</span> <span class="pl-s">"normal"</span> <span class="pl-c1">&&</span> <span class="pl-s1">data</span> <span class="pl-c1">===</span> <span class="pl-s">"i"</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
      <span class="pl-smi">this</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">mode</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s">"insert"</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
      <span class="pl-k">return</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
    <span class="pl-kos">}</span>
    <span class="pl-smi">super</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">handleInput</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">data</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>  <span class="pl-c">// App keybindings + text editing</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">}</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span>

<span class="pl-k">export</span> <span class="pl-k">default</span> <span class="pl-k">function</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">pi</span>: <span class="pl-smi">ExtensionAPI</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
  <span class="pl-s1">pi</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">on</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">"session_start"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">_event</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">ctx</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c1">=></span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">ctx</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">ui</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">setEditorComponent</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">_tui</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">theme</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">keybindings</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c1">=></span>
      <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-v">VimEditor</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">theme</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">keybindings</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
    <span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Key points:</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Extend <code>CustomEditor</code> (not base <code>Editor</code>) to get app keybindings (escape to abort, ctrl+d, model switching)</li>
<li>Call <code>super.handleInput(data)</code> for keys you don't handle</li>
<li>Factory receives <code>theme</code> and <code>keybindings</code> from the app</li>
<li>Pass <code>undefined</code> to restore default: <code>ctx.ui.setEditorComponent(undefined)</code></li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto">Register a custom renderer for messages with your <code>customType</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-ts notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="import { Text } from "@mariozechner/pi-tui";

pi.registerMessageRenderer("my-extension", (message, options, theme) => {
  const { expanded } = options;
  let text = theme.fg("accent", `[${message.customType}] `);
  text += message.content;

  if (expanded && message.details) {
    text += "\n" + theme.fg("dim", JSON.stringify(message.details, null, 2));
  }

  return new Text(text, 0, 0);
});"><pre><span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span> <span class="pl-v">Text</span> <span class="pl-kos">}</span> <span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s">"@mariozechner/pi-tui"</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

  <span class="pl-k">const</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span> expanded <span class="pl-kos">}</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">options</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
  <span class="pl-k">let</span> <span class="pl-s1">text</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">theme</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">fg</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">"accent"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">`[<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">${</span><span class="pl-s1">message</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">customType</span><span class="pl-kos">}</span></span>] `</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
  <span class="pl-s1">text</span> <span class="pl-c1">+=</span> <span class="pl-s1">message</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">content</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

  <span class="pl-kos">}</span>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Error Handling</h2><a id="user-content-error-handling" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Error Handling" href="#error-handling"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Extension errors are logged, agent continues</li>
<li><code>tool_call</code> errors block the tool (fail-safe)</li>
<li>Tool <code>execute</code> errors must be signaled by throwing; the thrown error is caught, reported to the LLM with <code>isError: true</code>, and execution continues</li>
</ul>

Here’s the focused summary you asked for:

## 1) `SKILL.md` frontmatter (especially `name` and `description`)

The doc states that a skill is a directory with a required `SKILL.md`, and `name`/`description` are **required** frontmatter fields. Frontmatter follows the Agent Skills spec, with additional constraints in this project.  
- Required: `name` and `description`  
- Optional: `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata`, `allowed-tools`, `disable-model-invocation`  
- `SKILL.md` format must be present in each skill directory, with frontmatter between `---` markers at the top. citehttps://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/docs/skills.md#frontmatter

### `name` rules (important)
- 1–64 characters
- lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens only
- no leading/trailing hyphens
- no consecutive hyphens
- must match the parent directory name  
Example: `pdf-processing` valid; `PDF-Processing` invalid.  
Also validated at load time, with warnings for mismatches/invalid chars; missing `description` means the skill is **not loaded**. citehttps://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/docs/skills.md#name-rules

### `description` guidance
- Required for loading; max 1024 chars.
- It should be specific, because it determines when the agent selects the skill.
- Good: mentions exact tasks/use-cases; poor: vague descriptions like “helps with PDFs.”  
citehttps://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/docs/skills.md#frontmatter citehttps://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/docs/skills.md#description-best-practices

---

## 2) Progressive disclosure model

Pi uses progressive disclosure for skills:

1. At startup, Pi scans configured skill locations and extracts **name + description**.  
2. System prompt gets available skills in XML summary form.  
3. Only when a task matches, full `SKILL.md` is loaded (via `read`, or explicitly via `/skill:name`).  
4. Thus, descriptions are in context by default, full

A skill provides specialized workflows, setup instructions, helper scripts, and reference documentation for specific tasks.","","Pi implements the [Agent Skills standard](https://agentskills.io/specification), warning about violations but remaining lenient.","","## Table of Contents","","- [Locations](#locations)","- [How Skills Work](#how-skills-work)","- [Skill Commands](#skill-commands)","- [Skill Structure](#skill-structure)","- [Frontmatter](#frontmatter)","- [Validation](#validation)","- [Example](#example)","- [Skill Repositories](#skill-repositories)","","## Locations","","\u003e **Security:** Skills can instruct the model to perform any action and may include executable code the model invokes. Review skill content before use.","","Pi loads skills from:","","- Global:","  - `~/.pi/agent/skills/`","  - `~/.agents/skills/`","- Project:","  - `.pi/skills/`","  - `.agents/skills/` in `cwd` and ancestor directories (up to git repo root, or filesystem root when not in a repo)","- Packages: `skills/` directories or `pi.skills` entries in `package.json`","- Settings: `skills` array with files or directories","- CLI: `--skill \u003cpath\u003e` (repeatable, additive even with `--no-skills`)","","Discovery rules:","- In `~/.pi/agent/skills/` and `.pi/skills/`, direct root `.md` files are discovered as individual skills","- In all skill locations, directories containing `SKILL.md` are discovered recursively","- In `~/.agents/skills/` and project `.agents/skills/`, root `.md` files are ignored","","Disable discovery with `--no-skills` (explicit `--skill` paths still load).","","### Using Skills from Other Harnesses","","To use skills from Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, add their directories to settings:","","```json","{","  \"skills\": [","    \"~/.claude/skills\",","    \"~/.codex/skills\"","  ]","}","```","","For project-level Claude Code skills, add to `.pi/settings.json`:","","```json","{","  \"skills\": [\"../.claude/skills\"]","}","```","","## How Skills Work","","1. At startup, pi scans skill locations and extracts names and descriptions","2. The system prompt includes available skills in XML format per the [specification](https://agentskills.io/integrate-skills)","3. When a task matches, the agent uses `read` to load the full SKILL.md (models don't always do this; use prompting or `/skill:name` to force it)","4. The agent follows the instructions, using relative paths to reference scripts and assets","","This is progressive disclosure: only descriptions are always in context, full instructions load on-demand.","","## Skill Commands","","Skills register as `/skill:name` commands:","","```bash","/skill:brave-search           # Load and execute the skill","/skill:pdf-tools extract      # Load skill with arguments","```","","Arguments after the command are appended to the skill content as `User: \u003cargs\u003e`.","","Toggle skill commands via `/settings` in interactive mode or in `settings.json`:","","```json","{","  \"enableSkillCommands\": true","}","```","","## Skill Structure","","A skill is a directory with a `SKILL.md` file. Everything else is freeform.","","```","my-skill/","├── SKILL.md              # Required: frontmatter + instructions","├── scripts/              # Helper scripts","│   └── process.sh","├── references/           # Detailed docs loaded on-demand","│   └── api-reference.md","└── assets/","    └── template.json","```","","### SKILL.md Format","","```markdown","---","name: my-skill","description: What this skill does and when to use it. Be specific.","---","","# My Skill","","## Setup","","Run once before first use:","\\`\\`\\`bash","cd /path/to/skill \u0026\u0026 npm install","\\`\\`\\`","","## Usage","","\\`\\`\\`bash","./scripts/process.sh \u003cinput\u003e","\\`\\`\\`","```","","Use relative paths from the skill directory:","","```markdown","See [the reference guide](references/REFERENCE.md) for details.","```","","## Frontmatter","","Per the [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io/specification#frontmatter-required):","","| Field | Required | Description |","|-------|----------|-------------|","| `name` | Yes | Max 64 chars. Lowercase a-z, 0-9, hyphens. Must match parent directory. |","| `description` | Yes | Max 1024 chars. What the skill does and when to use it. |","| `license` | No | License name or reference to bundled file. |","| `compatibility` | No | Max 500 chars. Environment requirements. |","| `metadata` | No | Arbitrary key-value mapping. |","| `allowed-tools` | No | Space-delimited list of pre-approved tools (experimental). |","| `disable-model-invocation` | No | When `true`, skill is hidden from system prompt. Users must use `/skill:name`. |","","### Name Rules","","- 1-64 characters","- Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens only","- No leading/trailing hyphens","- No consecutive hyphens","- Must match parent directory name","","Valid: `pdf-processing`, `data-analysis`, `code-review`","Invalid: `PDF-Processing`, `-pdf`, `pdf--processing`","","### Description Best Practices","","The description determines when the agent loads the skill. Be specific.","","Good:","```yaml","description: Extracts text and tables from PDF files, fills PDF forms, and merges multiple PDFs. <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Skills</h1><a id="user-content-skills" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Skills" href="#skills"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Skills are self-contained capability packages that the agent loads on-demand. A skill provides specialized workflows, setup instructions, helper scripts, and reference documentation for specific tasks.</p>
<p dir="auto">Pi implements the <a href="https://agentskills.io/specification" rel="nofollow">Agent Skills standard</a>, warning about violations but remaining lenient.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Locations</h2><a id="user-content-locations" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Locations" href="#locations"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Security:</strong> Skills can instruct the model to perform any action and may include executable code the model invokes. Review skill content before use.</p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">Pi loads skills from:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Global:
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>~/.pi/agent/skills/</code></li>
<li><code>~/.agents/skills/</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Project:
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>.pi/skills/</code></li>
<li><code>.agents/skills/</code> in <code>cwd</code> and ancestor directories (up to git repo root, or filesystem root when not in a repo)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Packages: <code>skills/</code> directories or <code>pi.skills</code> entries in <code>package.json</code></li>
<li>Settings: <code>skills</code> array with files or directories</li>
<li>CLI: <code>--skill <path></code> (repeatable, additive even with <code>--no-skills</code>)</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Discovery rules:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>In <code>~/.pi/agent/skills/</code> and <code>.pi/skills/</code>, direct root <code>.md</code> files are discovered as individual skills</li>
<li>In all skill locations, directories containing <code>SKILL.md</code> are discovered recursively</li>
<li>In <code>~/.agents/skills/</code> and project <code>.agents/skills/</code>, root <code>.md</code> files are ignored</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Disable discovery with <code>--no-skills</code> (explicit <code>--skill</code> paths still load).</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Using Skills from Other Harnesses</h3><a id="user-content-using-skills-from-other-harnesses" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Using Skills from Other Harnesses" href="#using-skills-from-other-harnesses"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">To use skills from Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, add their directories to settings:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-json notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="{
  "skills": [
    "~/.claude/skills",
    "~/.codex/skills"
  ]
}"><pre>{
  <span class="pl-ent">"skills"</span>: [
    <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>~/.claude/skills<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>,
    <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>~/.codex/skills<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
  ]
}</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">For project-level Claude Code skills, add to <code>.pi/settings.json</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-json notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="{
  "skills": ["../.claude/skills"]
}"><pre>{
  <span class="pl-ent">"skills"</span>: [<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>../.claude/skills<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>]
}</pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">How Skills Work</h2><a id="user-content-how-skills-work" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: How Skills Work" href="#how-skills-work"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>At startup, pi scans skill locations and extracts names and descriptions</li>
<li>The system prompt includes available skills in XML format per the <a href="https://agentskills.io/integrate-skills" rel="nofollow">specification</a></li>
<li>When a task matches, the agent uses <code>read</code> to load the full SKILL.md (models don't always do this; use prompting or <code>/skill:name</code> to force it)</li>
<li>The agent follows the instructions, using relative paths to reference scripts and assets</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">This is progressive disclosure: only descriptions are always in context, full instructions load on-demand.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Skill Commands</h2><a id="user-content-skill-commands" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Skill Commands" href="#skill-commands"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Skills register as <code>/skill:name</code> commands:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="/skill:brave-search           # Load and execute the skill
/skill:pdf-tools extract      # Load skill with arguments"><pre>/skill:brave-search           <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Load and execute the skill</span>
/skill:pdf-tools extract      <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Load skill with arguments</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Arguments after the command are appended to the skill content as <code>User: <args></code>.</p>
<p dir="auto">Toggle skill commands via <code>/settings</code> in interactive mode or in <code>settings.json</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-json notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="{
  "enableSkillCommands": true
}"><pre>{
  <span class="pl-ent">"enableSkillCommands"</span>: <span class="pl-c1">true</span>
}</pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Skill Structure</h2><a id="user-content-skill-structure" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Skill Structure" href="#skill-structure"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

└── assets/

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">SKILL.md Format</h3><a id="user-content-skillmd-format" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: SKILL.md Format" href="#skillmd-format"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Frontmatter</h2><a id="user-content-frontmatter" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Frontmatter" href="#frontmatter"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Per the <a href="https://agentskills.io/specification#frontmatter-required" rel="nofollow">Agent Skills specification</a>:</p>
<markdown-accessiblity-table><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Field</th>
<th>Required</th>
<th>Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>name</code></td>
<td>Yes</td>
<td>Max 64 chars. Lowercase a-z, 0-9, hyphens. Must match parent directory.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>description</code></td>
<td>Yes</td>
<td>Max 1024 chars. What the skill does and when to use it.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>license</code></td>
<td>No</td>
<td>License name or reference to bundled file.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>compatibility</code></td>
<td>No</td>
<td>Max 500 chars. Environment requirements.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>metadata</code></td>
<td>No</td>
<td>Arbitrary key-value mapping.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>allowed-tools</code></td>
<td>No</td>
<td>Space-delimited list of pre-approved tools (experimental).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>disable-model-invocation</code></td>
<td>No</td>
<td>When <code>true</code>, skill is hidden from system prompt. Users must use <code>/skill:name</code>.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></markdown-accessiblity-table>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Name Rules</h3><a id="user-content-name-rules" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Name Rules" href="#name-rules"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>1-64 characters</li>
<li>Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens only</li>
<li>No leading/trailing hyphens</li>
<li>No consecutive hyphens</li>

---

## 2) Progressive disclosure model

Pi uses progressive disclosure for skills:

1. At startup, Pi scans configured skill locations and extracts **name + description**.  
2. System prompt gets available skills in XML summary form.  
3. Only when a task matches, full `SKILL.md` is loaded (via `read`, or explicitly via `/skill:name`).  
4. Thus, descriptions are in context by default, full

pi can help you create pi packages. Ask it to bundle your extensions, skills, prompt templates, or themes.","","# Pi Packages","","Pi packages bundle extensions, skills, prompt templates, and themes so you can share them through npm or git. A package can declare resources in `package.json` under the `pi` key, or use conventional directories.","","## Table of Contents","","- [Install and Manage](#install-and-manage)","- [Package Sources](#package-sources)","- [Creating a Pi Package](#creating-a-pi-package)","- [Package Structure](#package-structure)","- [Dependencies](#dependencies)","- [Package Filtering](#package-filtering)","- [Enable and Disable Resources](#enable-and-disable-resources)","- [Scope and Deduplication](#scope-and-deduplication)","","## Install and Manage","","\u003e **Security:** Pi packages run with full system access. Extensions execute arbitrary code, and skills can instruct the model to perform any action including running executables. Review source code before installing third-party packages.","","```bash","pi install npm:@foo/bar@1.0.0","pi install git:github.com/user/repo@v1","pi install https://github.com/user/repo  # raw URLs work too","pi install /absolute/path/to/package","pi install ./relative/path/to/package","","pi remove npm:@foo/bar","pi list    # show installed packages from settings","pi update  # update all non-pinned packages","```","","By default, `install` and `remove` write to global settings (`~/.pi/agent/settings.json`). Use `-l` to write to project settings (`.pi/settings.json`) instead. Project settings can be shared with your team, and pi installs any missing packages automatically on startup.","","To try a package without installing it, use `--extension` or `-e`. This installs to a temporary directory for the current run only:","","```bash","pi -e npm:@foo/bar","pi -e git:github.com/user/repo","```","","## Package Sources","","Pi accepts three source types in settings and `pi install`.","","### npm","","```","npm:@scope/pkg@1.2.3","npm:pkg","```","","- Versioned specs are pinned and skipped by `pi update`.","- Global installs use `npm install -g`.","- Project installs go under `.pi/npm/`.","- Set `npmCommand` in `settings.json` to pin npm package lookup and install operations to a specific wrapper command such as `mise` or `asdf`.","","Example:","","```json","{","  \"npmCommand\": [\"mise\", \"exec\", \"node@20\", \"--\", \"npm\"]","}","```","","### git","","```","git:github.com/user/repo@v1","git:git@github.com:user/repo@v1","https://github.com/user/repo@v1","ssh://git@github.com/user/repo@v1","```","","- Without `git:` prefix, only protocol URLs are accepted (`https://`, `http://`, `ssh://`, `git://`).","- With `git:` prefix, shorthand formats are accepted, including `github.com/user/repo` and `git@github.com:user/repo`.","- HTTPS and SSH URLs are both supported.","- SSH URLs use your configured SSH keys automatically (respects `~/.ssh/config`).","- For non-interactive runs (for example CI), you can set `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` to disable credential prompts and set `GIT_SSH_COMMAND` (for example `ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5`) to fail fast.","- Refs pin the package and skip `pi update`.","- Cloned to `~/.pi/agent/git/\u003chost\u003e/\u003cpath\u003e` (global) or `.pi/git/\u003chost\u003e/\u003cpath\u003e` (project).","- Runs `npm install` after clone or pull if `package.json` exists.","","**SSH examples:**","```bash","# git@host:path shorthand (requires git: prefix)","pi install git:git@github.com:user/repo","","# ssh:// protocol format","pi install ssh://git@github.com/user/repo","","# With version ref","pi install git:git@github.com:user/repo@v1.0.0","```","","### Local Paths","","```","/absolute/path/to/package","./relative/path/to/package","```","","Local paths point to files or directories on disk and are added to settings without copying. Relative paths are resolved against the settings file they appear in. If the path is a file, it loads as a single extension. If it is a directory, pi loads resources using package rules.","","## Creating a Pi Package","","Add a `pi` manifest to `package.json` or use conventional directories. Include the `pi-package` keyword for discoverability.","","```json","{","  \"name\": \"my-package\",","  \"keywords\": [\"pi-package\"],","  \"pi\": {","    \"extensions\": [\"./extensions\"],","    \"skills\": [\"./skills\"],","    \"prompts\": [\"./prompts\"],","    \"themes\": [\"./themes\"]","  }","}","```","","Paths are relative to the package root. Arrays support glob patterns and `!exclusions`.","","### Gallery Metadata","","The [package gallery](https://shittycodingagent.ai/packages) displays packages tagged with `pi-package`. Add `video` or `image` fields to show a preview:","","```json","{","  \"name\": \"my-package\",","  \"keywords\": [\"pi-package\"],","  \"pi\": {","    \"extensions\": [\"./extensions\"],","    \"video\": \"https://example.com/demo.mp4\",","    \"image\": \"https://example.com/screenshot.png\"","  }","}","```","","- **video**: MP4 only. On desktop, autoplays on hover. Clicking opens a fullscreen player.","- **image**: PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP. Displayed as a static preview.","","If both are set, video takes precedence.","","## Package Structure","","### Convention Directories","","If no `pi` manifest is present, pi auto-discovers resources from these directories:","","- `extensions/` loads `.ts` and `.js` files","- `skills/` recursively finds `SKILL.md` folders and loads top-level `.md` files as skills","- `prompts/` loads `.md` files","- `themes/` loads `.json` files","","## Dependencies","","Third party runtime dependencies belong in `dependencies` in `package.json`. Dependencies that do not register extensions, skills, prompt templates, or themes also belong in `dependencies`. When pi installs a package from npm or git, it runs `npm install`, so those dependencies are installed automatically.","","Pi bundles core packages for extensions and skills. class="js-snippet-clipboard-copy-unpositioned BlobContent-module__markdownBlob__T8jpG" data-hpc="true"><article class="markdown-body entry-content container-lg" itemprop="text"><blockquote>
<p dir="auto">pi can help you create pi packages. Ask it to bundle your extensions, skills, prompt templates, or themes.</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Pi Packages</h1><a id="user-content-pi-packages" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Pi Packages" href="#pi-packages"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Pi packages bundle extensions, skills, prompt templates, and themes so you can share them through npm or git. A package can declare resources in <code>package.json</code> under the <code>pi</code> key, or use conventional directories.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Table of Contents</h2><a id="user-content-table-of-contents" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Table of Contents" href="#table-of-contents"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
